parsed.study_design: Utility case study and infrastructure-prioritization model development/application

parsed.outcome: Prioritized pipe segments, reduced planned replacement length, and reductions in expected capital spending; no measured household connection, availability, reliability, quantity, affordability, or exclusion outcome
parsed.rationale: The “Model Results and Application” section (pp. 1444–1445) reports changes in capital planning, including a reduction from approximately 13,000 to 10,000 feet of annual replacement and lower expected capital spending.
